description: MARKET-WIDE search of Schedule 13D / 13G beneficial-ownership filings by FILING DATE — no ticker needed. AUTHORITATIVE for "which activist investors filed new 13Ds this month and which companies did they target", "who disclosed a 5%+ stake in anything last week", "new 13G filings since Monday". Returns, per filing: the SUBJECT company (the issuer targeted, with ticker and CIK), the FILERS (investors / reporting persons, with CIK), form, filing date, and whether it is an amendment. By default only NEW filings (amendments excluded; set include_amendments true to add 13D/A and 13G/A). For the first `enrich` structured filings (post-2024 XML rule, default 5, max 10) it also reads the filing itself and adds the reporting owners' percent of class and shares owned, the event date, and — for 13D — the Item 4 "Purpose of Transaction" text (the activist signal). Rows beyond `enrich` carry the index fields only; pass their accession to sec_13d_filing for the full parse. `total_matches` is the true count for the window, `scanned` how many were read (at most 300), and `truncated` says honestly when the window held more than was scanned — narrow the date range rather than assuming completeness. Default window: the last 30 days.

end_date.description: Last filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

enrich.description: How many of the returned structured filings to read in full for percent of class and Item 4 purpose (0-10, default 5). Each is one SEC document fetch.

include_amendments.description: Include 13D/A and 13G/A amendments. Default false (new filings only).

limit.description: Max filings to return (1-100, default 25), newest first.

start_date.description: First filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days before end_date.

name: sec_13d_search
title: Sec 13d Search
